high_level_description: stc brand style, a close-up of traditional Middle Eastern tea preparation in the desert.

elements.desc: A person wearing a white thobe, seated cross-legged, holding a metal container.
A copper teapot with a long spout on a blue gas burner, two brown leather containers with metal lids, and a small glass cup, with a hand pouring liquid into the teapot.
